title: Structural Constraints on Entropy-Gradient Gravity from Cluster Merger Geometry
description: Reproducible constraint study testing whether Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) entropy-gradient formulations can reproduce Bullet Cluster lensing geometry without particle dark matter. The paper falsifies purely local gradient couplings (0/42 pass) and shows that a non-local, component-sensitive response with L0≈200 kpc and strong collisionless weighting (w≈20) can conditionally match the observed mass–gas separation, yielding falsifiable a priori predictions for MACS J0025 and Abell 520.

Geff_local.description: Local entropy-gradient coupling (v1.0) that modifies the effective gravitational response from the baryonic surface density Σ_b via its local logarithmic gradient.

kappa_EFC.description: EFC-predicted convergence map from baryons with modified effective coupling; Σ_c is the critical surface density for lensing.

q_grad.description: Edge-sensitive term measuring local gradient strength of the logarithmic baryonic surface density.

q_center.description: Center-sensitive term (Laplacian of log surface density) enhancing compact centers over edges.

q_mix.description: Component-blended structural signal combining center and edge responses with fixed mixing parameter β.

qbar_nonlocal.description: Non-local smoothing of q by convolution with a kernel G of characteristic scale L0.

Sigma_eff.description: Component-sensitive effective surface mass entering lensing: collisionless (stellar/galaxies) weighted by w relative to gas.

r_Mach.description: Rankine–Hugoniot compression ratio as a function of Mach number M for the intracluster medium.

tau_mix.description: Mixing timescale tying non-local scale L0 to a velocity dispersion σ_v with a single global parameter η.

w_saturating.description: Saturating collisionless weighting model favoring gradient preservation in collisionless matter; preferred over exponential for robustness to age uncertainties.

key_results.main_finding: Local gradient coupling is falsified (0/42 pass); a non-local, component-sensitive formulation conditionally reproduces Bullet Cluster geometry with best parameters α=1.5, L0≈200 kpc, w≈20.
datasets_used: Synthetic κ-maps reconstructed from published Bullet Cluster baryonic distributions
A priori predictions for MACS J0025 (synthetic validation)
A priori predictions for Abell 520 (geometry-only synthetic validation)

sealed_predictions.statement: Using locked parameters (η=66.2, α=1.5, β=0.3, c=0.8 so L0=0.8 Rcore, σv=500 km/s), the model will reproduce κ-peak geometry in MACS J0025 with w≈23.9 and L0≈120 kpc: two peaks, each within 50 kpc of the galaxy centroids and offset >100 kpc from gas; peak ratio between 0.9 and 1.2.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Reconstruction from real shear catalogs and X-ray maps; fail if any criterion is violated.

sealed_predictions.statement: With the same locked parameters, the model will reproduce κ-peak geometry in Abell 520 with w≈28.2 and L0≈160 kpc under the same geometric criteria.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint lensing (shear) and X-ray analysis on real data; fail if peak count, offsets, proximity, or peak ratio criteria are not met without parameter retuning.

kill_criteria: KC1: Bullet Cluster re-analysis on real shear catalogs cannot achieve two κ peaks within 50 kpc of galaxy centroids while maintaining >100 kpc offsets from gas using the v1.1 non-local model (α=1.5, β=0.3) even after calibration on Bullet; this falsifies the non-local EFC formulation for mergers.

KC2: Using locked global parameters (η=66.2, α=1.5, β=0.3, c=0.8, σv=500 km/s) and no per-cluster retuning, both MACS J0025 and Abell 520 fail any of the four geometry criteria (peak count=2, gas offset>100 kpc, galaxy proximity<50 kpc, peak ratio 0.9–1.2) on real data; this rejects the working hypothesis.

KC3: Best fits for any tested merger require collisionless weighting w≤1 (gas-coupling stronger than collisionless) or w≥50, or require L0 outside [0.3, 1.2]×Rcore; such requirements are deemed physically implausible and kill the model.

KC4: Reconstructed time-series (systems at different merger stages) demands w(M,t) decreasing with increasing Mach number or favors an exponential mixing law decisively (e.g., Δχ²>10 over the saturating law) across multiple systems; this contradicts the stated physical motivation.

KC5: The local gradient model (Geff ∝ |∇lnΣb|) passes the four geometry criteria in any well-observed dissociative cluster using real data; this overturns Claim BC-001 and invalidates the primary constraint of the paper.

related_packages.role: Analysis code and synthetic κ-map reconstructions used for the constraint study

abstract_short: Local entropy-gradient couplings falsified (0/42 pass). Required: non-local L₀~200 kpc, collisionless weighting w~20.
limitations: Synthetic κ-maps, not real FITS data
